brief_rationale: The doctor used the available workspace and caregiver-read documents to distinguish orders from final culture/susceptibility results, maintained uncertainty, and built a concrete follow-up pathway. Medication execution was reconciled around the label and later treating-team advice, with repeated warnings not to self-change antibiotics. Closure was safe and bounded: pending culture/drug-susceptibility and puncture reports remained open, but the caregiver had timing, owners, contingency triggers, and gave teach-back. Multiple high-order points were completed with meaningful trajectory impact, so the trajectory meets Perfect.
